decision: Retain the technically qualified native release. The uninterrupted 44-hour portfolio completed 10557 polls with independently reconciled account change 33.28070452355614 USD, including marked open positions. The weekday/weekend comparison is complete and interpreted. The prepared 94-file backend patch is installed and the already installed TUI retained. The separate installed-path 18-case native verification passes against exact archived source imports. Record fresh unsigned venue/account preflight with existing ownership kept distinct from a flat profile transition. These are observed technical results and deployment evidence; they do not establish future profitability. No backend or financial transaction was started.
falsifier: Contradictory ownership, unexplained quantity/cash, duplicate dispatch or economics, source/import mismatch, incomplete accounting, unbounded recovery, or an unexplained native boundary difference reopens the affected technical assessment. New venue facts update the timestamped preflight. Subsequent outcome evidence may change strategy expectations independently of whether the technical fixes remain correct.
hypothesis: The current native seven-asset lifecycle can be replayed with causal acquisition and receipt clocks, exact submitted quantities, independently reconciled shared economics and explicit venue-model boundaries.
limitations: High confidence is scoped to named technical results; profitability and unseen execution paths remain uncertain.
The control windows each started with 5000 USD and are not added as an independently measured continuous return.
Retrospectively captured candles and known partial outcomes do not provide bitemporal or untouched prospective validation.
Fees, venue metadata, latency, stop triggering, finite depth, collateral and source freshness retain the scenario contracts and declared limits.
Final open positions are marked; poll-sampled exposure/drawdown and the final checkpoint clock have explicit scope.

Fresh and continuous candle histories have different left boundaries. Recursive indicators, threshold diagnostics and three simulated protective stops differ; the complete comparison and bounded causal reconstruction retain those differences.
Synthetic seven-asset execution controls do not prove market-driven entries or stable strategy frequency for every asset.
Read-only preflight observations are sequential and timestamped. Existing SNDK exposure is not profit from the new release.
The installed source changed technical execution/recovery behavior, with no profile/strategy-parameter change; this append-only publication itself has no execution authority.
Final live-money start remains user-run. The conditional release estimate is not a promise of defect-free software or profitable outcomes.
